requirements.description: User prefers energy class C or better, so the accepted classes are A1 through A4, B and C. Area, capacity, Turin location and public transport access are not covered by the available columns and are not filtered here.

User wants the property located near public transport. Per the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71), this sets a strong proximity threshold for metro, bus and station access.
The project is a university student residence, so proximity to schools and universities is strongly desired. Using the 75th percentile of the education distribution (75.14, rounded to 75).

The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area, so this is a direct surface threshold. The capacity of 60 people is not converted into an area filter. The energy class, public transport proximity, and the Turin location are outside the reference columns and are handled by other agents or ignored here. The future student-residence use is not used to infer the current typology.
